artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan adding an advisory, mode-aware cycle_budget_advisory field to orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's per-task dispatch rows at admission time, with fixtures, two documentation homes, and a redeploy plus full-gate phase.

memory_candidates.content: When designing a derived admission-layer signal that compares two facts, the correct emission site is the earliest point at which EVERY operand is knowable -- and an operand whose value is chosen per-invocation (a mode flag, a per-run budget) is structurally never knowable at artifact-authoring time, only at command time. This settles 'warn at authoring time or at admission time' decisions without guesswork: if any operand is invocation-scoped, an authoring-time warning can only be operand-blind (guessing a future flag or using a worst case), which is a materially weaker signal than the exact admission-time computation that costs nothing extra to obtain. The corollary for implementation: compare against the SAME values the enforcing mechanism itself reads (here, a shared batch-wide pool rather than a per-task counter), because a notice that disagrees with the mechanism that actually enforces the limit is actively misleading rather than merely imprecise.
